title: 第91章 林美丽流产
content_zh:
第91章 林美丽流产-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

九月十六，这天是赵素梅的生日。

他提前去县城给赵素梅买了两身新衣服，买了两双新鞋。

亲手给赵素梅做了长寿面，过了个简单的生日。

傍晚时分，店里客人正多。

赵素梅坐在柜台后面收钱，林薇在柜台里面的小板凳上玩布偶兔子，林静在旁边拿着蜡笔在本子上写写画画。

门口忽然传来一阵骚动。

一个人影从街对面跌跌撞撞跑过来。

披头散发，脸上青一块紫一块，嘴角挂着血。

左胳膊不自然地垂着，像是断了。

身上穿着的那件碎花褂子，扯破了好几处，沾着泥和血。

是林美丽。

她赤着一只脚，另一只脚上的布鞋跑掉了。

跑到店门口，整个人扑倒在门槛上。

“二哥……”

赵素梅面色骤变，她腾地站起来，手里的算盘碰落在地上。

店里吃饭的客人都停下了筷子。

林美丽趴在地上，抬起头。

脸上没有一块好地方，眼睛肿得只剩一条缝。

她伸手抓住门槛，指甲缝里全是泥和血。

“二哥……救我！王超把我锁在屋里……我跳窗户跑出来的……”

林国强从后厨走出来。

他系着围裙，手上还沾着面粉。

低头看着趴在地上的林美丽，脸上没有什么表情。

赵志军从后厨探出头，看见这一幕，手里的锅铲差点掉了。

“去报警。”林国强说。

赵志军解了围裙就往外跑。

赵素梅扶着肚子蹲下来，想扶林美丽起来。

就在这时，街对面冲过来一个人。

是王超。

他满脸通红，一身酒气，眼睛里全是血丝。

看见趴在国强饭店门槛上的林美丽，他像疯了一样冲过来。

“你个臭娘们！还敢跑！”

他一把抓住林美丽的头发，把她往外拖。

赵素梅就蹲在林美丽旁边，王超这一下太猛，拖着林美丽往后一拽，林美丽的身体撞到了赵素梅的腿。

赵素梅失去平衡，整个人往后仰去。

那一瞬间，林国强的瞳孔猛地收缩。

他离赵素梅有三步远。

三步，根本来不及。

但林美丽动了。

看见赵素梅挺着大肚子要摔，她猛地挣脱了王超抓着她头发的手……被扯掉了一大把头发。

她整个人扑到地上，用自己的身体垫在了赵素梅身下。

赵素梅仰倒在她身上，被林美丽垫住了。

赵志军冲回来的时候，看见的是这一幕。

September 16th is Zhao Sumei’s birthday.

He went to the county town in advance to buy two new clothes and two pairs of new shoes for Zhao Sumei.

I personally made longevity noodles for Zhao Sumei and had a simple birthday.

In the evening, there were many customers in the store.

Zhao Sumei was sitting behind the counter collecting money, Lin Wei was playing with a stuffed rabbit on the small bench inside the counter, and Lin Jing was writing and drawing in a notebook with a crayon next to her.

Suddenly there was a commotion at the door.

A figure stumbled across the street.

His hair was disheveled, his face was bruised and bruised, and there was blood at the corner of his mouth.

The left arm hung unnaturally, as if it was broken.

The floral gown he was wearing was torn in several places and stained with mud and blood.

It's Lin Meili.

One of her feet was bare, and the cloth shoe on the other foot ran away.

He ran to the door of the store and threw himself on the threshold.

"Second brother..."

Zhao Sumei's expression changed suddenly. She stood up and the abacus in her hand fell to the ground.

All the diners in the restaurant stopped using their chopsticks.

Lin Meili lay on the ground and raised her head.

There was no good spot on his face, and his eyes were so swollen that there was only a slit left.

She reached out and grabbed the threshold, her fingernails filled with mud and blood.

"Second brother...save me! Wang Chao locked me in the room...I jumped out of the window and ran out..."

Lin Guoqiang walked out of the kitchen.

He was wearing an apron and his hands were still stained with flour.

He looked down at Lin Meili lying on the ground, with no expression on his face.

Zhao Zhijun poked his head out of the kitchen and almost dropped the spatula in his hand when he saw this scene.

"Go to the police." Lin Guoqiang said.

Zhao Zhijun took off his apron and ran outside.

Zhao Sumei squatted down with her belly in hand, trying to help Lin become more beautiful.

Just then, a man rushed over from across the street.

It's Wang Chao.

His face was red, he smelled of alcohol, and his eyes were bloodshot.

Seeing Lin Meili lying on the threshold of Guoqiang Hotel, he rushed over like crazy.

"You stinky bitch! How dare you run!"

He grabbed Lin Meili's hair and dragged her out.

Zhao Sumei was squatting next to Lin Meili. Wang Chao's move was too strong and he dragged Lin Meili back. Lin Meili's body hit Zhao Sumei's leg.

Zhao Sumei lost her balance and leaned back.

At that moment, Lin Guoqiang's pupils shrank suddenly.

He was three steps away from Zhao Sumei.

Three steps, too late.

But Lin Meili moved.

Seeing that Zhao Sumei was about to fall with her big belly, she suddenly broke away from Wang Chao's hand holding her hair... and a lot of hair was torn out.

She threw herself on the ground and used her body to cushion Zhao Sumei.

Zhao Sumei fell on her back and was cushioned by Lin Meili.

When Zhao Zhijun rushed back, he saw this scene.
